class.name: DSTextureCache
class.brief_description: Thread-safe least-recently-used cache for DirectStorage textures.
class.description: [DSTextureCache] provides an optional thread-safe least-recently-used (LRU) cache for loaded [Texture2D] resources. The extension registers it as the [Engine] singleton named [code]"DSTextureCache"[/code]. When enabled, the resource loader can query and store textures according to the requested cache mode ([constant CACHE_MODE_REUSE], [constant CACHE_MODE_IGNORE], or [constant CACHE_MODE_REPLACE]).

method.name: add_alias
method.description: Binds [param alias_path] as an alias pointing to the canonical cached entry for [param canonical_path] without consuming an additional cache slot.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every cached texture and unbinds all aliases.

method.name: evict
method.description: Removes the cached texture stored under [param path] (or its canonical entry if [param path] is an alias) and unbinds associated aliases.

method.name: get_cached
method.description: Returns the cached texture for [param path] (resolving any alias to its canonical entry) and marks it as recently used unless [param cache_mode] ignores or replaces caching. Returns [code]null[/code] when no entry exists or caching is disabled.

method.name: get_canonical_path
method.description: Returns the canonical path for [param path]. If [param path] is an alias, returns the canonical primary path it points to; if it is already canonical, returns [param path]; otherwise returns an empty string.

method.name: get_cached_count
method.description: Returns the number of textures currently cached.

method.name: get_max_entries
method.description: Returns the maximum number of entries retained by the cache.

method.name: get_pending_prewarm_count
method.description: Returns the number of prewarm textures for [param tag] that have not finished yet. Pass [code]0[/code] (the default) to count every tag.

method.name: is_cache_mode_ignored
method.description: Returns whether the given [param cache_mode] specifies bypassing cache storage and lookup ([constant CACHE_MODE_IGNORE] or [constant CACHE_MODE_IGNORE_DEEP]).

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns whether the texture cache is actively enabled.

method.name: poll_completed
method.description: Builds finished prewarm textures and stores them in the cache under their engine path. Only requests matching [param tag] are processed; pass [code]0[/code] (the default) to poll every tag. Returns the number of textures stored by this call. Failed or cancelled requests are skipped here and load normally later through the regular loader.

method.name: prewarm_async
method.description: Enqueues engine texture paths for asynchronous streaming prewarm and returns the stream tag. File remapping is resolved internally, and paths already in the cache are skipped without enqueueing. Track the tag with [method DSContext.is_prewarm_complete] and [method DSContext.get_prewarm_progress], or stop it early with [method DSContext.cancel_prewarm]. Returns [code]0[/code] when the extension is unavailable.

method.name: has_alias
method.description: Returns whether [param alias_path] is currently registered as an alias in the cache.

method.name: remove_alias
method.description: Unbinds [param alias_path] from its canonical cached entry without removing the canonical texture itself.

method.name: set_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables the texture cache. Disabling the cache clears all currently retained entries.

method.name: set_max_entries
method.description: Sets the cache capacity. Values less than [code]1[/code] are clamped to [code]1[/code]; excess oldest entries are evicted immediately.

method.name: store
method.description: Stores [param texture] under [param path] (optionally registering [param alias_path] as a shared secondary key without consuming extra capacity) and marks it as recently used if caching is enabled and [param cache_mode] is not ignored. Null textures are ignored.

members.member: Whether the texture cache is enabled. When disabled, queries return [code]null[/code] and new entries are not stored.
Maximum number of textures retained by the least-recently-used cache.

constants.constant: Queries the cache and stores the loaded texture if caching is enabled.
Bypasses cache lookup and updates or replaces the existing cache entry.
Bypasses caching for this resource and any nested sub-resources.
